folds.heading: ## Later direction and palette routing, 2026-11-04 (B75)
folds.body: The quoted one-realm/one-prestige milestone describes this receipt’s older direction snapshot. Weibao retired it on October 24; current PROJECT/USER_VISION preserve deeper existing systems, several paths and mechanically distinct worlds, with actual selected slices sequenced. F21’s older weaponcraft routes are followed by the retained supersession stubs and canonical [weaponcraft/rune owner](../../WEAPONCRAFT_RUNES_AND_INSCRIPTION_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-14.md); B56 records their exact identity/history limits. Neither correction changes the historical index input, source pins or proposal status. Human review is optional under AD42, and this note supplies no underlying code/canon review (AD32/AD36).
